PROJECT REPORT
One Day Beautician Workshop for Ladies Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East

Date: 19 October 2026
Venue: Rotary Centre, Mulund East
Time: 10:30 AM onwards
Beneficiaries: 25 women

On the auspicious occasion of the 9th day of Navratri, the Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East organised a One Day Beautician Workshop for Ladies to empower women to care for their well-being, personal grooming and self-confidence.

The workshop was conducted by Nakshatra Salon, led by *Nisha Vikram Kadam*- and her team, who patiently introduced the participants to the basics of skincare, hair care and personal grooming. Along with practical self grooming techniques, Nisha shared a powerful message: a woman must take care of herself and her health, too.

Emotional Impact and Ladies’ Testimony
The workshop touched the hearts of all 25 participants. Many women shared that they spent most of their time caring for their families and meeting everyone else’s needs, leaving little or no time for themselves.

One participant said, “I have always taken care of my family, but I never thought of taking care of myself. Today, I realised that I also deserve time, care and happiness.”

This heartfelt testimony reflected the true impact of the initiative. For the women, the workshop was not merely about makeup or grooming it was a reminder that they are important, valued and deserving of care.

The happiness on their faces and their sincere gratitude made the session deeply meaningful. At the conclusion of the workshop, the ladies thanked the Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East, Nisha and Nakshatra Salon for giving them an opportunity to learn, feel confident and do something special for themselves.

Certificates and Gift Hampers
To make the experience memorable, certificates and gift hampers were distributed to all participants. Each lady also received a personalised bag sponsored by Nakshatra Salon.
